Context: 11. Sexual Harassment of working women

5. of sexual nature.  
- The following circumstances, among other circumstances, if it occurs or is present in relation to or connected with any act or behaviour
- 1-A. of sexual harassment may amount to sexual harassment:-
- (i)
- implied or explicit promise of preferential treatment in employment, or
- (ii)
- (iii)
- implied or explicit threat of detrimental treatment in employment; or
- implied or explicit threat about her present or future employment status; or
